SELECT p.product_id AS productId, p.product_name AS title, p.price AS price, p.main_image_url AS imageUrl, p.region_display_name AS regionName, p.created_at AS createdAt,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_favorites uf WHERE uf.product_id = p.product_id ) AS likeCount,
CASE WHEN #{loginUserId} IS NULL THEN false ELSE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_favorites uf WHERE uf.product_id = p.product_id AND uf.user_id = #{loginUserId} ) END AS liked
FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
WHERE ( c.category_id = #{categoryId} OR c.parent_id = #{categoryId} ) AND p.sales_status = 'ON_SALE'
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
